_comment: Locale registry for overseas-geo-question-bank/v8. Adding a language means adding an entry here — no validator code change. Each entry supplies the four fixed templates (with and without the scope clause), the company/product object labels, and the nouns used to detect Discovery candidate requests.

en.name: English
en.category_awareness: What is a {category}, and how should I evaluate one?
en.category_awareness_scoped: What is a {category}, and how should I evaluate one for {scope}?

th.category_awareness_scoped: {category} คืออะไร และควรประเมินอย่างไรสำหรับ {scope}?
